description: Poll an accepted job for free. A paid job reports processing, ready, or failed without revealing its result before settlement; retry_after_s gives the next polling delay, capped at two minutes. An uncertain payment reports needs_review with no automatic retry: keep the job ID and contact support without another payment. After confirmed settlement, retrieve the saved result.
